sources.snippet: 🚀 ColSmolVLM-Instruct-256M: Visual Retriever based on SmolVLM-Instruct-250M with ColBERT strategy ColSmolVLM-Instruct-256M is a model that uses a novel architecture and training strategy based on Vision Language Models (VLMs) to efficiently index documents from their visual features. This is a version trained with batch_size 32 for 3 epochs.
